blindReviewDeclaration: Independent findings and verdict were formed from the mandatory checklist, governing sources, current design, manifest, authorization, catalog/checker/verifier, and canonical HMAC owners before author intake was read.

riskClasses: receipt identity and no-replace collision safety

expectedBehavior: The catalog admits exactly the matrix-derived 17 ACTIVE machine-enforcement refs: one VERIFY_ROOT, fifteen VERIFY_CHILD, and one ARCHUNIT_SELECTOR; missing, extra, duplicate, unknown-kind, and subset admissions fail.

VERIFY_ROOT has dependency hashes but no command or successMarkers; child and selector entries require command and markers; executeActive accepts only the child partition while root and selector use their dedicated paths.

A root invocation obtains rootRunId from crypto.randomUUID(), reserves its derived receipt path without replacement before any child, rejects an existing path with VERIFY_RECEIPT_PATH_EXISTS without overwrite, and validates the same invocation identity through --expected-root-run-id.

The shared database-operation canonical owner preserves the nine-field byte sequence including statementId ?? empty string; an omitted statementId has byte-for-byte pre-extraction equivalence and changes to that behavior fail.
This review is static DESIGN-only and does not assert implementation, dynamic execution, business, cleanup, performance, Testcontainers, DEV, L2, seed, reset, browser, UAT, or deployment success.

findings.title: THCL-U02 approved-source anchor does not bind the canonical Claude N-01 heading
findings.evidence: The manifest declares `### N-01｜`rootRunId` 的“不可预测”未指定来源；receipt path 已存在时的行为未指定`, while the hash-bound Claude source contains only `### N-01｜`rootRunId` 的"不可预测"未指定来源`. Recomputing the exact literal occurrence count gives 0, and `scripts/check/implementation-design-granularity --manifest ...claude-remediation-granularity-manifest.json --review ...claude-remediation-round1.json` fails `UNIT_SOURCE_THCL-U02_1_ANCHOR_NOT_UNIQUE:0` before review-content validation.
findings.risk: The N-01 design logic is explicit, but the current manifest cannot provide its required unique owning-source trace or pass its fail-closed static checker until the anchor is corrected.
findings.disposition: Correct the manifest's THCL-U02 approvedSources[0].anchor to the exact canonical N-01 heading and renew its hash-bound review path; this is a documentation-binding correction only, not implementation or runtime authority.

solutionReasonableness.problemFit: The repair directly reconciles Claude M-01 by retaining the frozen full matrix denominator while making catalog fields and execution paths mutually kind-aware; it separately closes the bounded N-01 receipt and N-02 canonical-byte ambiguities.
solutionReasonableness.simplerAlternativeAssessment: Keeping the former unconditional command schema would make VERIFY_ROOT impossible; weakening the catalog to children or adding a parallel runner would lose root or selector coverage. The selected schema-v2 partition reuses the existing catalog, checker, verifier, and HMAC owner with the smallest bounded change surface.
solutionReasonableness.costFit: The added controls are finite mechanical predicates with concrete red mutations and do not claim dynamic evidence or create a new general governance system.

conclusion.summary: Independent static DESIGN review found no M or S finding. The design fixes the kind conflict without weakening the 17-ref denominator, specifies UUID/no-replace receipt safety, and preserves statementId nullish canonical bytes through a single owner and red proof. One N finding records the current manifest's non-binding N-01 source anchor, which prevents its static granularity check from admitting the hash-bound manifest until corrected.
conclusion.authorizationBoundary: Static DESIGN-only verdict. It does not authorize implementation or any source, test, runner, contract, active-package, dynamic-environment, business, cleanup, performance, Testcontainers, DEV, L2, seed, reset, browser, UAT, or deployment action.
